cards.text: Israel is camped in the plains of Moab along the Jordan, across from Jericho (Numbers 22:1). The Reubenites and the Gadites, two of Israel's tribes, have very large herds and flocks, and I mean SO many animals, friend. They take a good long look at the lands of Jazer and Gilead.

cards.question: The Reubenites and Gadites look over Jazer and Gilead. They see the region is suitable for ___.

cards.text: So they go to Moses, Israel's leader, Eleazar the priest and the leaders of the congregation, and rattle off nine towns the LORD conquered, all good for livestock, and hey, they just happen to have livestock. That's not a conversation, friend, that's a REAL ESTATE TOUR.

cards.question: The Gadites and Reubenites start with, "If we have found favor in your sight," and then comes the big ask. What is it?

answers.text: Let them have this land and not cross
Let them have more of the war spoil
Let them take the best land in Canaan

cards.question: Moses loves the plan from the Gadites and Reubenites and says yes right away.

cards.text: Moses asks them, "Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?" Everybody's got that one friend who "helps" with the big move by holding the door OPEN.

cards.question: Moses has a second question for the Gadites and Reubenites. What does he say they're doing to the rest of Israel?

answers.text: Taking the best pasture for themselves

cards.question: Moses says someone discouraged Israel from entering the land like this before. Who does he say did it?

cards.text: Back at Kadesh-barnea, Moses sent their fathers to inspect the land, and at the Valley of Eshcol they saw it and discouraged the Israelites from going in. That's a one-star review, friend, and the WHOLE camp read it.

cards.question: Back then, after their fathers discouraged Israel, the LORD's anger was kindled and He swore an oath.
In His oath, the LORD says the men who came out of Egypt won't see the land. Which men?
The LORD's oath has two exceptions: ___ son of Jephunneh and ___ son of Nun.

cards.text: Caleb the Kenizzite and Joshua were two of the men who scouted the land (Numbers 14:6), and the LORD says they followed Him wholeheartedly. Out of that whole generation, friend, TWO names, and that tells you how much wholehearted matters.

cards.question: How long does the LORD make Israel wander, until that whole generation is gone?

cards.text: Now Moses calls them "a brood of sinners," risen up in place of their fathers to stoke the LORD's anger even more. Moses did NOT put that one in a cookie box with a little bow on top.

cards.question: Moses warns the Gadites and Reubenites: if they turn away from following the LORD, He will leave Israel in the ___ again.

cards.text: Moses ends with, "you will be the cause of their destruction." Then the Gadites and Reubenites come back with a new pitch: sheepfolds here for their livestock and cities for their little ones, and friend, I'm LISTENING.

cards.question: The new plan from the Gadites and Reubenites has one more part. Their men will ___ themselves and go ahead of the Israelites.
The Gadites and Reubenites promise not to go home until every Israelite has taken his inheritance.

cards.text: And they won't take an inheritance with everyone else across the Jordan, because theirs has come to them on the east side. Friend, they are DONE house hunting.
Moses answers the Gadites and Reubenites with a big IF. If they arm themselves before the LORD for battle, and every armed man crosses the Jordan until He has driven His enemies out...

cards.question: If the Gadites and Reubenites arm themselves and cross the Jordan for battle until the land is subdued, what does Moses say they get?

answers.text: They may go home and the land is theirs
They get first pick of land in Canaan
They get to lead every tribe in battle

cards.question: Moses tells the Gadites and Reubenites that if they don't keep their word to fight, nobody will ever know.

cards.text: Moses tells them they'd be sinning against the LORD, and "your sin will find you out." Sin is like cookie crumbs on your apron, friend: you THINK nobody notices, and EVERYBODY notices.

cards.question: Moses tells the Gadites and Reubenites to go ahead and build cities for their little ones and folds for their flocks. But he adds one thing. What is it?

answers.text: Pay a tribute to the LORD

cards.question: Moses says build, but keep the promise. How do the Gadites and Reubenites answer?

answers.text: They will do just as Moses commands
They ask for time to think it over
They offer to send half their men

cards.text: The Gadites and Reubenites say their children, wives, livestock and animals will stay in the cities of Gilead, but every man is equipped for war and will cross over to the battle before the LORD. EVERY man, friend, not just whoever's free that weekend.

So Moses gives orders to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the family leaders of the tribes: if the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan armed for battle and the land is subdued, they are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession. The whole leadership team heard it, friend, so nobody gets to say "I don't remember that."

cards.question: Moses adds one more rule for the leaders. If the Gadites and Reubenites don't arm themselves and cross with the others, where must they take their land?

answers.text: Among the other tribes in Canaan
In the land of Gilead anyway

cards.question: The Gadites and Reubenites tell Moses they will do just as the ___ has spoken to them.

cards.text: The Gadites and Reubenites say they'll cross into Canaan armed before the LORD, so their inheritance can be on this side of the Jordan. Deal SEALED, friend, and now Moses hands out the land.

cards.question: Moses gives land east of the Jordan to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of ___.

cards.text: That half-tribe comes from Manasseh son of Joseph, and Moses gives the Gadites, the Reubenites and that half-tribe the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, with their cities and the territory around them. Two whole KINGDOMS, friend, and back in that junk drawer I had to share my corner with a twist tie.

The Gadites build up Dibon, Ataroth, Jazer and more as fortified cities with folds for their flocks, and the Reubenites build up Heshbon, Nebo and others and rename the cities they rebuild. New owners ALWAYS change something, friend.

cards.question: The descendants of Machir, son of Manasseh, go to Gilead and capture it. What do they do with the Amorites who are there?
Moses gives Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settle there.

cards.text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, goes and captures villages and calls them Havvoth-jair. Look at that name, friend: JAIR is right there in it.

cards.question: After Nobah captures Kenath and its villages, he keeps the name Kenath.
